summary: Practise user research, journey mapping, concept selection and prototype testing in design thinking training. Explore the course outline.
lede: Design thinking gives product, service and operations professionals a structured way to turn user evidence into testable concepts. The training supports practical work on a product or service challenge through interview planning, journey mapping and problem framing, then low-fidelity prototyping and usability-test planning to gather feedback before committing resources.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who shape, deliver or improve services and products and need a repeatable way to connect user evidence with decisions. It is designed for foundation-level learners, including professionals who have not previously facilitated a full design-thinking cycle.
modules: Design Thinking Evidence and Action Plan
prerequisites: No prior design-thinking training is required. You should bring a workplace service, product or process challenge that you can discuss without disclosing confidential user information.
